messages:
Maria: Heads-up — ZephyrWorks renewal ~6w out. Seat activity down 72% over the last 14d, API calls down ~65%. Procurement pinged asking about competitor proof-of-concept. Need quick triage and playbook.
Alex: Ack. Is the drop across their org or specific routes/apps?
Maria: Prod only, mostly /v1/generate and embedding calls. Quick query I ran:
```sql
-- last 14 days by route
SELECT route, count(*) as calls
FROM api_events
WHERE customer_id = 'zephyr_123' AND ts > now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY calls DESC;
```
Emma: Looping in PS — @Tess can you run a targeted enablement? they mentioned onboarding docs were thin for embedding sharding.
Tess: I can do a 45m walkthrough Thu 10am PT. I'll prep a checklist (ingest patterns, batching, quantization tradeoffs).
Raj: FYI they surfaced CloudFox embeddings pilot — cost + latency pitch. I can flag procurement questions, but curious if we can offer a short Dedicated trial instead of a price cut.
Darren: If embeds + generate both tanked, could be KV cache miss pattern after their spike. Can you share a couple sample request IDs or a small log extract so I can correlate across pods?
Maria: Pasting two request IDs and a tiny log excerpt below: req: zfw-req-7712, zfw-req-7729
```
[2026-03-22T14:12:03Z] zfw-req-7712 route=/v1/embeds latency=1320ms status=200 kv_cache_hit=false
[2026-03-22T14:12:08Z] zfw-req-7729 route=/v1/generate latency=1580ms status=200 kv_cache_hit=false
```
deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-22_14:00 -> prod succeeded :white_check_mark:
Alex: Proposed playbook quick: 1) immediate enablement (Tess) 2) Darren to triage KV/cache + pod metrics 3) Raj to surface procurement/competitor ask and propose trial credits 4) Emma to schedule weekly QBR until renewal closed 5) Maria to own single pane tracker.
Emma: I'll create the calendar invite and include architecture review + cost comparison. Thu 10am PT tentative — sending invite now. :calendar:
Raj: I'll prep a short procurement brief showing competitor delta and ask for a 30-day dedicated trial credit option. cc: finance@redwood
Darren: I'll run a trace on the two req IDs and check cache eviction metrics + kernel failures. Expecting initial findings by EOD.
Maria: Thanks — action items noted. I'll update the tracker and ping exec sponsor if we don't see re-engagement by Friday. :thumbsup:
Tess: I'll attach the enablement deck + quickstart snippets to the invite.
Maria: Bringing in CS Ops to confirm credits process — @Emma can you confirm what we can offer without legal sign-off?
Emma: We can approve up to 1 week of dedicated credits from CS Ops. Anything beyond needs finance OK. I'll confirm the exact number in the invite thread.
Maria: Closing loop for now. We'll reconvene after Darren's findings and the Thu session. Thanks team.
